notes.title: Update March 2016!
notes.notes:
We’ve pushed up another update to the game! Once again we’ve taken any feedback into consideration and tweaked the game to address the concerns. Lots of fixes to the later levels and game wide tweaks to the spawning and AI of the Orcs.
Update list:
•	Fixed some AI issues with the Orcs
•	Fixed some more spawning issues
•	Fixed a bunch of minor bugs
•	More explosive barrels!
•	More pickups!
•	A few graphical tweaks
•	Collision improvements and other level tweaks
